In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
They all handle the sword, and are expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh, because of fear in the night.

translations.web: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
translations.bsb: Therefore, He recognizes their deeds; He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
translations.kjv: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
translations.asv: Therefore he taketh knowledge of their works; And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
